messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH latency SLO burn (p96) for inference-hosting-prod across eu-west-1. Current burn: 42% over 10m threshold. Alert: https://dash.redwood.example/slo/latency?range=10m :rotating_light:

pagerduty: New incident RI-2241 created and notified: oncall -> maya. PagerDuty link: https://pd.example/incidents/RI-2241

maya (oncall): acking — I'm on it, switching phone to silent for the call but will post updates here. :thumbsup:

lucas (sre): joining. quick checks: rolling p95->p99 spike or broad? can someone paste SLO drill-down?

nina (eng): from the dashboard it looks like a tail increase on short requests (seq len < 256) — p96 jumps, qps steady. KV cache hit-rate fell ~15% at the same time.

lucas (sre): ty. checking autoscaler events and pod restarts now.

ops-bot: k8s events snapshot:
```
NAMESPACE           NAME                                        READY   STATUS    RESTARTS
inference-prod      model-server-5c8b7d6f9f-ptx2l               2/2     Running   0
inference-prod      model-warmup-collector-78b4df9c9-ktj4x      1/1     CrashLoopBackOff  3
```

lucas (sre): hmm crashloop on warmup collector — could explain cache warmups and KV miss flood. tailing the collector logs now.

maya (oncall): pager duty timeline: incident declared critical. Customer-facing comms? james can you chime in on impacted tiers?

james (product): early signals from Support: a handful of enterprise customers in EU report elevated latency (5–12s on generation) but no widespread 500s. sounds like slowdown, not outage. tag priority: P1 for potential SLA impact.

nina (eng): log tail shows repeated timeouts to redis-kv in eu-west-1 around 11:02:12. example:
```
ERROR kv_client: timeout 1500ms connecting to redis-eu-west1-1
```
We have retry/backoff spikes that correlate with p96 tail.

lucas (sre): launching mitigation: 1) take warmup collector out of rotation; 2) scale up redis replica group to reduce tail; 3) temporarily increase model-server replicas by +2 to smooth batching. Applying step 1 now.

ops-bot: kubectl patch deployment model-warmup-collector -n inference-prod --replicas=0 -> succeeded

maya (oncall): acknowledged. lucas, nina, keep me posted on redis scaling. I'll notify CS and update PD incident notes.

lucas (sre): scaling redis set: aws rds-replica: increasing replica count and vertical bloat; kicking off MIGRATION job. ETA ~6m for new read-replica.

nina (eng): also flipping short-term config: reduce batch_max_delay from 30ms to 10ms to prioritize latency (will increase cost). Applying to route inference-short in prod.

ops-bot: patch applied to route inference-short: {"batch_max_delay_ms":10} -> rollout started

lucas (sre): redis replica available. Re-checking KV hit-rate, should start improving as replicas warm.

maya (oncall): support note drafted: "We're seeing elevated request latency for some EU customers; engineering is investigating and applying mitigations (cache scaling and batching config). We'll provide ETA in 15m." Posting to #support-ops.

james (product): thanks. let's avoid broad comms unless it persists past 30m.

nina (eng): after batch tweak + warmup collector OOR, p96 dropped from 1.8s to 0.9s in the last 3m. KV miss-rate trending down.

lucas (sre): good. leaving autoscaling watch on. enabling extra logging for correlation IDs to ensure no silent errors.

maya (oncall): is a rollback to the previous model variant needed? any model change recently?

nina (eng): no model push in the last 24h. it's infra degradation (redis warmup + collector crashloop). rollback not needed.

pagerduty: Incident RI-2241 acknowledged by maya (oncall) at 2026-03-14T11:15:42Z

maya (oncall): marking progress. Mitigations applied: warmup collector OOR, redis replica added, batching tightened. Observed latency improvement but SLO burn still at ~8% over 5m window — continuing to monitor and will escalate if >15% or if p99 climbs.

james (product): for post-incident: let's track customer list, PV of latency by tenant, and consider runbook update to include warmup collector healthcheck and autoscale for KV.

lucas (sre): agreed. opening infra ticket INF-7623 for warmup collector root cause and autoscaling. assigning to infra team.

maya (oncall): handoff plan: I'll stay on to complete initial RCA notes, then hand to next oncall @lucas in 25m for follow-up. If things regress, page oncall again.

ops-bot: scheduled oncall rotation reminder: @lucas will be primary at 11:40Z.

maya (oncall): thanks team. leaving a short summary in the PD incident and closing slack thread when stable. :white_check_mark:
